name: send-email-lambda
description: Lambda to send emails via SES using templates from S3

scripts.build: npm run build:cognito && npm run build:notifications
scripts.zip: cd dist && zip ../lambda-cognito.zip lambda_send_email_cognito.js && zip ../lambda-notifications.zip lambda_send_email_notifications.js && cd ..
scripts.zip:windows: powershell -Command "Compress-Archive -Path dist\lambda_send_email_cognito.js -DestinationPath lambda-cognito.zip -Force" && powershell -Command "Compress-Archive -Path dist\lambda_send_email_notifications.js -DestinationPath lambda-notifications.zip -Force"

author: Twingers Corporation
